hero.title: Data understanding starts with understanding people.
hero.subtitle: Cognitive intelligence for BI and decision support.
body: CogniCheck helps BI professionals improve the full dashboard trajectory: from requirements and assumptions, to blueprinting, to cognitive analysis of reports.

sections.title: Dashboards do not fail only because of data.
body: Many dashboards are technically correct, but cognitively ineffective. Users struggle with unclear priorities, visual overload, hidden assumptions and reports that do not clearly support a decision.
CogniCheck helps teams design BI solutions around how people actually perceive, interpret and act on information.

cards.title: Requirements & assumptions
cards.body: Turn vague dashboard requests into sharper decision questions. Identify ambiguity, hidden assumptions and unclear stakeholder expectations.

cards.title: Requirements to blueprint
cards.body: Translate business requirements into a structured BI blueprint: key metrics, data sources, modelling implications, risks and next steps.

cards.title: Cognitive report analysis
cards.body: Analyze screenshots of reports using principles from cognitive psychology, including attention, gestalt structure, working memory and cognitive load.

cards.title: Decision support
cards.body: Improve the link between data, interpretation and action, so dashboards become tools for better decisions rather than static reporting objects.

sections.title: Built on cognitive psychology
body: CogniCheck looks at dashboards through the lens of human cognition. The goal is not only to make reports look better, but to make them easier to understand, easier to use and more useful for decision-making.

cards.title: Attention
cards.body: What receives the most visual emphasis, intentionally or unintentionally?

cards.title: Structure
cards.body: Are related metrics grouped in a way that supports interpretation?

cards.title: Working memory
cards.body: Does the user see the answer directly, or must they reconstruct it mentally?

cards.title: Change visibility
cards.body: Are deviations, comparisons and changes made explicit?

sections.title: Try CogniCheck in a demo
body: Upload a dashboard screenshot and receive a structured cognitive analysis with scores, observations and practical improvement suggestions.
CogniCheck can also help convert requirements documents into BI blueprints, making the early phase of dashboard development more explicit and testable.

list: From report builder to trusted advisor

sections.title: About CogniCheck
body: CogniCheck was created by Robin Groen, a BI analyst with a background in psychology, management and data analytics.
The project started from a simple belief: good BI is not only about data. It is about helping people understand complexity and make better decisions.
